label: Activate Python Venv Terminal
args: if [ -d "$ZED_WORKTREE_ROOT/.venv" ]; then cd "$ZED_WORKTREE_ROOT" && bash --rcfile <(echo "source ~/.bashrc; source .venv/bin/activate"); else cd "$ZED_WORKTREE_ROOT" && python3 -m venv .venv && bash --rcfile <(echo "source ~/.bashrc; source .venv/bin/activate"); fi
